title: PH, France strengthen agricultural ties

blocks.text: MANILA, Philippines — The Philippines and France have agreed to strengthen their agricultural collaboration, focusing on farm trade, research, food safety, animal health, and climate-resilient agriculture. “Our partnership with France is important as we work to make Philippine agriculture more productive, competitive and resilient,” Agriculture Secretary Francisco Tiu Laurel Jr. said in a statement on Thursday. READ: France backs PH food security program with €200M funding “Stronger cooperation means greater opportunities to bring in technology, knowledge and investments that can benefit our farmers and strengthen our food systems,” he added.
